mapper.sql: nearby_settings.radius_m AS nearby_radius_m, nearby_data.spot_data_available, nearby_data.facility_data_available, CASE WHEN nearby_data.spot_data_available THEN nearby_spots.view_spot_count END AS view_spot_count, CASE WHEN nearby_data.spot_data_available THEN nearby_spots.stair_spot_count END AS stair_spot_count, CASE WHEN nearby_data.facility_data_available THEN nearby_facilities.toilet_count END AS toilet_count, CASE WHEN nearby_data.facility_data_available THEN nearby_facilities.parking_count END AS parking_count

CROSS JOIN (SELECT 200 AS radius_m) nearby_settings CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trail_spot s WHERE s.mountain_id = c.mountain_id AND s.dup_of_spot_id IS NULL AND s.verify_status_cd <> 'REJECTED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM spot_tag t WHERE t.spot_id = s.spot_id AND t.verify_status_cd <> 'REJECTED' ) ) AS spot_data_available, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM facility f WHERE f.mountain_id = c.mountain_id AND f.dup_of_facility_id IS NULL AND f.verify_status_cd <> 'REJECTED' ) AS facility_data_available ) nearby_data CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(DISTINCT s.spot_id) FILTER (WHERE t.tag_cd = 'VIEW') AS view_spot_count, count(DISTINCT s.spot_id) FILTER (WHERE t.tag_cd = 'STAIR') AS stair_spot_count FROM trail_spot s JOIN spot_tag t ON t.spot_id = s.spot_id WHERE s.mountain_id = c.mountain_id AND s.dup_of_spot_id IS NULL AND s.verify_status_cd <> 'REJECTED' AND t.verify_status_cd <> 'REJECTED' AND t.tag_cd IN ('VIEW', 'STAIR') AND ST_DWithin(s.geom, c.geom, nearby_settings.radius_m) ) nearby_spots CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.fac_type_cd = 'TOILET') AS toilet_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.fac_type_cd = 'PARKING') AS parking_count FROM facility f WHERE f.mountain_id = c.mountain_id AND f.dup_of_facility_id IS NULL AND f.verify_status_cd <> 'REJECTED' AND ST_DWithin(f.geom, c.geom, nearby_settings.radius_m) ) nearby_facilities
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM course WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND del_yn = 'N'

WITH page_courses AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT course_id, mountain_id, course_nm, memo, create_type_cd, length_m, est_time_min, frst_regist_dt, calc_difficulty_cd, geom FROM course WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY course_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) SELECT c.course_id::text, c.mountain_id::text, m.mountain_nm, c.course_nm, c.memo, c.create_type_cd, c.length_m, c.est_time_min, c.frst_regist_dt, c.calc_difficulty_cd,
FROM page_courses c JOIN mountain m ON m.mountain_id = c.mountain_id
ORDER BY c.course_id DESC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mountain WHERE mountain_id = #{mountainId} AND use_yn = 'Y')

SELECT c.course_id, c.mountain_id, c.course_nm, c.memo, c.create_type_cd, c.rev_no, CASE WHEN ST_SRID(c.geom) = 5179 AND GeometryType(c.geom) = 'LINESTRING' AND ST_NDims(c.geom) = 2 AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(c.geom) AND ST_IsValid(c.geom) THEN ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Transform(c.geom, 4326), 15, 0) END AS geometry_json, c.length_m, c.xmin::text AS row_version, COALESCE(ST_SRID(c.geom) = 5179 AND GeometryType(c.geom) = 'LINESTRING' AND ST_NDims(c.geom) = 2 AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(c.geom) AND ST_IsValid(c.geom), false) AS geometry_valid FROM course c WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} AND c.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND c.del_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF c

INSERT INTO course ( mountain_id, owner_user_id, course_nm, memo, create_type_cd, del_yn, rev_no, geom, length_m, est_time_min, src_difficulty_mix_json, calc_difficulty_cd ) VALUES ( #{mountainId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{courseName}, #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createType}, 'N', 1, ST_GeomFromEWKB(decode(#{geometryHex}, 'hex')), #{lengthM}, NULL, NULL, NULL ) RETURNING course_id
mapper.update:
UPDATE course
course_nm = #{courseName}, memo = #{memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
geom = ST_GeomFromEWKB(decode(#{geometryHex}, 'hex')), length_m = #{lengthM}, rev_no = rev_no + 1, est_time_min = NULL, src_difficulty_mix_json = NULL, calc_difficulty_cd = NULL,
WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND del_yn = 'N'
UPDATE course SET del_yn = 'Y' WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: WITH input_geometry AS ( SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(#{geometryJson}), 4326) AS geom ), projected AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN ST_IsValid(geom) AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) AND GeometryType(geom) = 'LINESTRING' AND ST_NDims(geom) = 2 THEN ST_Transform(geom, 5179) END AS geom FROM input_geometry ), area_rows AS ( SELECT geom, COALESCE(ST_SRID(geom) = 5179 AND ST_NDims(geom) = 2 AND GeometryType(geom) = 'MULTIPOLYGON' AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) AND ST_IsValid(geom), false) AS valid FROM service_area WHERE mountain_id = #{mountainId} AND use_yn = 'Y' ), area AS ( SELECT count(*) > 0 AND COALESCE(bool_and(valid), false) AS available, ST_Union(CASE WHEN valid THEN geom END) AS geom FROM area_rows ), measured AS ( SELECT geom, round(ST_Length(geom)::numeric, 1) AS length_m, COALESCE(GeometryType(geom) = 'LINESTRING' AND ST_SRID(geom) = 5179 AND ST_NDims(geom) = 2 AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) AND ST_IsValid(geom), false) AS valid FROM projected ) SELECT encode(ST_AsEWKB(m.geom), 'hex') AS geometry_hex, m.length_m, m.valid AND m.length_m > 0 AND m.length_m <= 99999999.9 AS valid, a.available AS area_available, CASE WHEN a.available AND m.valid THEN ST_Covers(a.geom, m.geom) ELSE false END AS covered, COALESCE((SELECT ST_OrderingEquals(c.geom, m.geom) FROM course c WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId,jdbcType=BIGINT}), false) AS same_geometry FROM measured m CROSS JOIN area a
